reason: Tracks provider token usage from dsh session events, estimates or records costs with configurable pricing, and presents aggregates through local web UI and JSON endpoints.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh 中汇总会话和回合的提供商 Token 使用量，按可配置的高峰与非高峰价格计算费用，并通过网页界面和 JSON API 展示结果。
summaries.en: Aggregates provider token usage by dsh session and turn, calculates costs with configurable peak and off-peak pricing, and displays the results through a web interface and JSON API.

capabilities: reads provider usage events from durable session logs
aggregates token usage by session and turn
calculates costs using configurable peak and off-peak pricing
serves a local overview page and JSON API
adds token usage indicators and a Token tab to the dsh web GUI
